name: operons
description: Transcription units (C5 TUs) with their detection, abundance and flag summaries (GIPPA_SPEC.md §9.3; M6-07, M6-08).

fields.name: end
fields.description: TU end, 1-based closed; > replicon length for an origin-crossing TU

fields.name: genes
fields.description: Semicolon-joined member genes in transcription order

fields.name: detected_frac
fields.description: Detected fraction of the non-partial member genes; NA when none is eligible

fields.name: median_abundance_log2
fields.description: Median log2 abundance of the detected member genes

fields.name: max_abs_delta_log2
fields.description: Largest |delta_log2| over internal adjacent pairs with both genes detected

fields.name: n_flags
fields.description: Flagged OP pairs with both genes in the TU
